server.title: Search Fragments
server.description: Pieces together films, shows, songs, books, quotes, places and studies from remembered fragments.

serverInfo.name: search-fragments-mcp
serverInfo.description: Search Fragments is an MCP server with four tools for questions an agent can't place. gate_probe: call first for any question; a few seconds, returns QUICK_LOOKUP (answer with a quote from the page), NEEDS_FULL_JOB (worth a full search) or NOT_WORTH_IT (SF's one look found no page naming an answer). resolve_fragment: the full search for half-remembered, cross-source queries; returns Found with sources, Leads to follow, or Not reachable. verify_claim: checks a specific factual assertion against current web sources, with cited evidence. submit_resolution_feedback: reports whether a resolve_fragment result was accepted, partial or rejected, using its resolution_id. Built to decline rather than guess.
